records.title: ModuleRegistryRepository is durable module registry truth and rejects duplicate identifiers after test-first repair
records.observed_behaviour_from_read_evidence: ModuleRegistryRepository persists module registry records by module_id, now rejects empty identifiers and duplicate module_id writes, and returns defensive copies on readback.
records.test_first_gap_or_action: The new Tier A test was written before source repair and initially failed because empty module IDs were accepted and duplicate module IDs silently overwrote existing records. The bounded repair changed only src/nvda_desk/repositories/module_registry.py to reject empty and duplicate identifiers.
adjudication_notes: This record transforms donor module/import-registry/promotion ideas into the active repo-native persistence seam rather than admitting donor services or schemas.
Promotion-service methods such as record_decision/list_decisions remain deliberately absent from this repository surface.
limitations: This record does not implement or admit a PromotionService, imported_modules schema package, module schema API, or downstream placement handoff policy.
This record does not claim all transform-required ACABC-0040 donor ideas are fully implemented; it records the bounded active persistence seam proven in this pass.
